author: The Current
description:
Bad Bad Hats' Kerry Alexander talks about the album featuring covers of her band's songs from "Psychic Reader"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

The year 2025 marked the 10th anniversary of Bad Bad Hats' debut full-length album, "Psychic Reader." As part of the 10th anniversary, Bad Bad Hats coordinated the release of "Psychic Readings," a collection that features a reimagining of every track from the original album, all by artists who the band has toured or recorded with over the last decade, like Hippo Campus, Gully Boys, Party Nails, Ratboys, Sombear and others. 

In an interview with The Current's Jill Riley, Bad Bad Hats frontperson Kerry Alexander talks about how the covers album "Psychic Readings" came together. “It’s not very often that you get to experience a song you wrote in a fresh, exciting, surprising way,” Alexander says.

Credits
Guest – Kerry Alexander of @badbadhats 
Host – Jill Riley
Producer – Nilufer Arsala

title: Kerry Alexander of Bad Bad Hats talks about the 'Psychic Readings’ covers album
